title: Psychedelic Dream Chase
description: A vibrant surreal scene features a large green dog covered in black swirling patterns running across a black and white wavy ground. In the sky, a woman with pink hair in a green outfit shoots a glowing green cat with a bow and arrow while standing on a colorful hot air balloon basket alongside a man in a suit. A giant red concentric eye vortex dominates the blood-red cloudy sky, with multiple UFOs and floating symbols.
